page.layout: Two parallel columns, left and right, of Hebrew-Latin dictionary entries. Below the columns: signature "K k" at the lower left and a catchword "מפרש" at the lower right. Running head in Hebrew at the top of each column. No margin notes.

page.notes: Faint and broken print throughout, with ink spots and speckling, especially in the Hebrew vocalisation. Hebrew forms are copied from what is visible and may contain errors where vowel points or consonants are not clear. Uncertain Hebrew readings: "מַפִּיל?" at the start of the left column's second entry, "[?]" after "No. pl." in the entry "opera ejus", and the vocalisation of several forms. The page number at the top right is too damaged to read. The entries are rendered as paragraphs; the source has one line per entry in places, but the entries are complete. Some Latin is partly obscured by ink, notably "expendens", "dissipatus", and "declaratus".
